searchText: So the focus for tomorrow's call is mostly on L2? Should we still have our AA slidedeck ready? <@!378595508748550145> ^^ <@!689161464829050960> its gonna be on the rollup centric roadmap that vitalik share on ethresarch + ETH2 would love to do another one on account abstraction tho sometime; if ud come back another week in october? I think we would be okay with that. Seems like rollups really is a hot topic right now, so probably a sensible pivot for tomorrow. Does it still make sense for us to join the call tomorrow then? I guess we could briefly talk about how future advanced mainnet features like AA would fit into the L2 vision (does it still make sense to bring those to mainnet?)... Or should we just say we completely move it and leave you to the rollup people tomorrow? 😉
